title: a project without jitso/jitso.yaml has no allowlists: every catalog command exits 3 with a message that says what to create
source: intended: builds come from the repo's jitso/builds folder and from drafts (docs/decisions.md, The v0.1.0 cut)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-12, build layers, narrowed by the v0.1.0 cut). The allowlists every build is validated against come from the launching project's jitso/jitso.yaml; without it no build can be validated, so build list and launch exit 3 with `jitso: jitso/jitso.yaml is missing: this project has no JITSO allowlists (create it with jitso build new <id>)`.
